claims.temporal_assessment: Documented at Army entry on 26 July 1943; it is not proven to be immediately before OSS service.
claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer. The combined historical category is preserved without narrowing the trade.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 152 to interpret the literal identifier and test the separate Hilary H. Crawford Jr. Army candidate. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index page 97; literal seven-digit value preserved without padding; complete Army identifier and exact-name comparison; CIA and current Library of Congress checks; Hilary, Hilary H, and Jr. variants; exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, institutional, newspaper, military, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The literal value matches an unrelated Army name; a name-only Hilary H. Crawford Jr. row and later club and memorial references lack a private identifier, OSS assignment, or Box 152 bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: The plausible name-only Army candidate remains private and unassigned. No authenticated NARA Catalog request was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 152 to interpret the index value and test the Army candidate.
